serie: Detrás de la góndola: un ex repositor y encargado de supermercado cuenta cómo funciona el súper por dentro y cómo comprar sin caer
estilo: One ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a family member with a phone at eye level, in the middle of the action: framing casual and a little off, something cut by the edge of the frame, almost everything in focus and nothing blurred out, only the light the place really has (a ceiling bulb, a lamp or the daylight from the window or door), automatic white balance a bit off, slight phone noise, ordinary worn objects, people caught mid-movement and not posing, no beautiful composition.

claudio.desc: a 72-year-old Latin American man with thick short curly silver-white hair, a short white beard, deep wrinkles and age spots, warm dark brown eyes and a wise calm look, wearing a faded navy polo shirt under a plain dark green apron with no logo, a small white badge reading CLAUDIO and a yellow price-labeling gun in the apron pocket

ramon.desc: don Ramón, a heavy-set 65-year-old supermarket manager in the 1990s with a gray mustache, white short-sleeve shirt and a dark tie, holding a clipboard

negra.desc: la Negra, a 45-year-old Latin American cashier with dark curly hair tied back, wearing a light blue cashier smock

lugares_fijos.pasillo: the aisle of an ordinary neighborhood supermarket in Latin America: long metal gondola shelves full of generic unbranded packages, white shelf-edge price labels, a worn speckled vinyl floor, long fluorescent tubes on the ceiling, a shopping cart left half-way
lugares_fijos.deposito: the back storeroom of a neighborhood supermarket: gray metal racks with cardboard boxes, a wooden pallet with shrink-wrapped boxes, a pallet jack, a bare fluorescent tube, a swinging door with a small round window to the sales floor
lugares_fijos.fiambreria: the deli counter of a neighborhood supermarket: a curved glass refrigerated display with cheeses and cold cuts on steel trays, a slicer machine, a white digital scale with a small label printer, white tiles behind
lugares_fijos.carniceria: the meat case of a neighborhood supermarket: an open refrigerated case with plastic-wrapped meat trays on white foam, white price labels, some trays with a red markdown sticker
lugares_fijos.caja: the checkout of a neighborhood supermarket: a black conveyor belt, a scanner window glowing red, a small customer display, a thermal receipt printer, candy racks next to the belt

identidad: Preserve the exact identity, face, thick short curly silver-white hair, short white beard, deep wrinkles, age and skin tone of the man in the reference photograph. He wears a faded navy polo shirt under a plain dark green apron with no logo and a small white badge reading CLAUDIO.
